description.html: A 20x20 cm base and 30 cm of height give 12 liters of volume in a vertical format. On the back is a 3D background of carved styrofoam, and ventilation is through a mesh vent. It takes up the space of a smaller flowerpot, so it fits on a bookshelf. We cut and glue the glass for this model by hand in Novi Sad.

For an adult jumping spider this is a spacious home: it has height for a nest near the top and enough walls for hunting. For mantises, 30 cm is enough for molting in most species kept as pets. Small day geckos and small tree frogs can stay here as juveniles, with one vertical branch and a plant.

We build the same base in four heights: 15, 30, 35 and 40 cm, so choose according to the species. You decide the pattern of the outer film and the shape of the background when ordering. For other sizes, or several connected compartments in a row, contact us with a sketch. We finish small custom terrariums in 7 to 14 days and ship them by courier.
